leads:
A. BACKEND BUG (byte-exact, semantically wrong): the F5-prefix (r32+) mnemonics for 0x31/0x41 are swapped. `f5 e0 31` is lda XBC,(XWA+) (C idiom p=q++) but llvm-mc prints `stb_dpi a, 224`; `f5 e8 41` is ld (XDE+),A but prints `lda_dpi xbc, 232`. Verified with unidasm on synthetic bytes and by the code's own use. 228 such lines tree-wide in v10 alone; lane files annotated via scripts/tools/seqeng_annotate_swapped_dpi.py (`; = ld (xde+),a (backend mnemonic is swapped)`). Also: no llvm-mc syntax exists for post-increment operands (`ld (xde+),a` is a parse error; `ld (+xde),a` silently assembles an ABSOLUTE address expression -- a trap). Other llvm prints misname registers while round-tripping: `cpda8 xbc,(8990)` is cp A,(0x231E); `addda16 xwa,(..)` is add WA; `andda16 xhl` is and HL; `div xwa,xbc` is div XWA,BC. The reframe tool's agree()/respell() handles these.
B. BACKEND: unspellable encodings listed in not_done #1 (shift-by-A, (r32+r16)+immediate forms, 0x85-prefixed ldi/ldir, rlc N,W).
C. PHANTOM POINTER in v10/v9 ui_widgets/widget_dispatch.s (:8834 / :8854): `.long SeqByteBlock_PathNormalize` covers bytes d7 00 f5 00, which are two LE16 coordinates (215, 245) in a row table like its neighbours. Write `.short 0x00d7, 0x00f5` there; then delete `.set SeqByteBlock_PathNormalize, . + 1` in smf_event_processor.s.
D. v7 LABELS for other lanes: notes/seqeng-2026-09-25/v7-unlabelled-call-targets.txt (scripts/analysis/seqeng_v7_call_targets.py). Biggest: v7 0xFDD69E inside DSPCfg_EventType50+157 = v10 Audio_CheckSubsystemReady (66 calls); 0xFF081D inside Free_Block4+12 = Memset (18); 0xFF05BC inside StrSearch_Init+2 = Mem_Copy (17); 0xFDC028 = DSPCfg_ReadParam_Map0 (15); 0xFF043B inside VoiceParam_DispatchTable1+3 = Math_DivideU32 (11); 0xFDAA53 inside SysEx_ValidateRolandHeader+20 = AddswbWr (11). The v7 library region has coarse/misnamed labels. After labels exist: `python3 scripts/converters/seqeng_symbolize_imm.py v7 --apply`.
E. F. SEMANTICS for the docs/naming lanes: VoiceSynth_CommandDispatch compares the byte at 0x0FAC with 0x20,0x26,0x40,0x42,0x43,0x5B,0x5D,0x60-0x65 = MIDI CC numbers (bank LSB, data-entry LSB, hold, sostenuto, soft, reverb, chorus, data inc/dec, NRPN, RPN) -> VoiceSynth_Algorithm_Table / VoiceParam_ReadUpdate_Table are [INFERENCE] CC 0..15 handler tables; VoiceSynth_DataEntry_PtrTable + VoiceChannel_ParamLimitTable (12/127/255) look like GM RPN 0/1/2; several handler names there (VoiceSynth_Cmd_Pan for 0x40 = hold, Scoop_Cmd_ReleaseVoiceSlot for NRPN select, NoteOn/OffByCh for RPN select) look wrong. Mode byte 0x11F8 != 1 swaps MIDI channels 10 and 16 through four tables. smf_event_processor.s contains a compiled-C FAT12/FAT16 module (file +30 volume, +38 sector buffer, +42 first cluster, +44 run length; volume +24 FAT start, +36 highest cluster, 0xFFF = FAT12): ~20 functions left to name after FatPath_Next83Component, Fat_ReadEntry, Fat_CountContiguousClusters; SeqStep_FileIoCheck (14 calls) is the cached sector fetch.
